text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Here we go, it's the Kokura Kinen, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Actually, before the race,
I went to pray at Dazaifu Tenmangu.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Dazaifu Tenmangu,
that's the shrine dedicated to the renowned Sugawara no Michizane-sama.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's one of Fukuoka's two greatest sacred sites,
so the divine blessings are extraordinary!
choice_data_list: What about the other sacred ground?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you don't know it?
That famous place...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then I've got a great idea.
If we make it through this race safely...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's go together to celebrate!
Ehehe, now I'm getting more and more pumped up!
